stdout:
usage: nacre-brain [-h]
                    {init,path,search,note,git,guard,store-credential,run-with-credential} ...

Small, account-independent Markdown knowledge vault and credential references.

positional arguments:
  {init,path,search,note,git,guard,store-credential,run-with-credential}
    note                Read a Markdown note from stdin; write a unique dated file
    git                 Initialize or inspect private git version history
    guard               Scan staged paths before commit
    store-credential    Prompt privately and store a credential in the OS keyring
    run-with-credential
                        Supply a keyring secret directly to a child environment

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
